title: Why Do We Laugh? The Evolutionary Puzzle of Humor
question: What is humor for, and why did a species under constant survival pressure evolve the capacity to find things funny?
summary: Laughter predates language, shows up in rats and chimpanzees, and burns real calories and attention for no obvious survival payoff. Explaining why a species shaped by natural selection spends so much of its social life chasing something as apparently frivolous as a joke turns out to be a genuinely hard problem in evolutionary psychology.
